title: Every Alexander Lady Bulldog earns All-Academic honors — a first in at least a decade
excerpt: All 18 players on the Alexander High School varsity volleyball roster earned District 30-6A All-Academic honors, each with a GPA of 92 or higher — the first time in at least a decade the whole roster has done it.
content:
The Alexander High School volleyball team is known as a powerhouse on the court. Now the Lady Bulldogs have done something no Alexander roster has done in at least a decade: every one of the 18 athletes on the varsity roster qualified for the District 30-6A All-Academic team, according to United ISD.

That means every member of the varsity roster earned a grade point average of 92 or above. Texas rules require only a 70 average to stay eligible for high school sports, the district noted — these players hold themselves to a much higher standard.

Head coach Ariana Bermea Mendoza said it is the first time in her 10 years at Alexander that every single member of the varsity roster earned the honor. The team advanced to the Sweet 16 this season.

Senior Eva Martinez carries a weighted GPA of 106, takes college classes through the Early Start Pathway and Advanced Placement courses, and has applied to the University of Texas at Austin, where she hopes to study biology on her way to a career in medicine. She left a tournament early once to take the SAT, and said the players used bus rides to finish homework and scheduled schoolwork around practice.

Fellow senior Andrea Garcia carries a weighted GPA of 105, has also applied to UT-Austin, and plans to study civil engineering — a field that interests her because her father is an architect. She said she is proud of how the team performed this season, including the run to the Sweet 16, and of the work and sacrifice it took to get there.

The rest of the district's volleyball programs also did well in the classroom: 15 of the 16 Lady Longhorns earned All-Academic honors, along with 13 Lady Panthers and seven Lady Wolves, according to United ISD.

Sources: United ISD, Nov. 11, 2026; uisd.net.
